description: Create a reinforcement element. When reinforcement is used with fully deformable blocks, the blocks must be discretized into zones before reinforcement locations are specified.

keywords.name: by-line
keywords.description: Create the elements by defining a line from v1 to v2 . A reinforcement element will be created at each intersection of the line and a joint.

keywords.name: cid
keywords.description: Set the collection ID of the reinforcements. By default, a single collection ID is assigned to all reinforcement elements created with a single command.

keywords.name: group
keywords.description: Group created reinforcement elements in the group s1 (in the slot named s2 , if supplied).

keywords.name: property
keywords.description: Set the property number assigned to the reinforcement.
